function.name: compute_statistics
function.description: This function calculates key statistical measures, such as the mean, median, and mode, of a given dataset. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

data.description: An array of numerical values for which statistical measures will be computed.

include_variance.description: A flag indicating whether to include variance in the output. By default, variance is not included.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places to round the computed statistics to. The default is 2 decimal places.
